Dr. Shyu-Tu Lee 李學圖

scholar

 

English Name

Dr. Shyu-Tu Lee

漢文名

李學圖 博士

Birth Year

1940

Birth Place

Taipei, Taiwan

First year, first city and state in the U.S.

1967, East Lansing, Michigan

Address

Vancouver, WA

Family

1.Wife: Margaret

2.Daughter: Adabel

3.Son: Anton

Education

1.University of Michigan

(Ann Arbor)

1978

M.S. Transportation Eng.

2. Western Michigan Univ.

1985

D.P.A Public Administration

Employment

1.Michigan Department of Transportation

1970-1997

Engineer; Manager; Administrator, Engineer & Scientific Data Center; Assistant Chief Information Officer

2.Univ. of Michigan (Flint)

1995

Adjunct faculty member

3.Clark County Public Works, WA

1997-2001

Transportation System Manager

Accomplishment

1. Highway Transportation Research and Education Fellowship award (1976) from the U. S. Department of Transportation

2. Dissertation was selected as one of the ten finalists for the 1986 Doctoral Dissertation Award given by the National Association of Schools for Public Affairs and Administration.

3. Invited by the United Nations Development Program to provide training course and consultation for the development of a geographic information system to the Highway Department of Yunnan province, China (1995)

4. Served as Chair of Research Committee (2009-2010), President (2011), Co-Chair of Think-tank Committee (2014-2015) of the North America Taiwanese Professors’ Association.

Publication (if any)

1. <孕育台灣人文意識--50好書> (2007/09)

2. “評選最能提升國民素養與國家認同的100佳作”，其資料被編成, <閱讀台灣、人文100>. 2008/12

3. <台灣的品格--進步國民的素養與智識> (2010/10)

4. Taiwan's Struggle--Voices of the Taiwanese (2014/02)

5. 40 professional papers.

Hobby

1.Reading

2.Travelling

Notable Accomplishments

Highway Transportation Research and Education Fellowship award (1976) from the U.S. Department of Transportation

Dissertation selected as one of ten finalists for the 1986 Doctoral Dissertation Award by the National Association of Schools for Public Affairs and Administration

Invited by the United Nations Development Program to provide training and consultation for the development of a geographic information system to the Highway Department of Yunnan province, China (1995)

Author of publications including Taiwan's Struggle--Voices of the Taiwanese (2014) and 40 professional papers
